benefits_summary: Collateral-free micro-enterprise loans up to ₹10,00,000 (Shishu up to ₹50k, Kishore up to ₹5L, Tarun up to ₹10L, Tarun Plus up to ₹20L) for non-farm small businesses.
exclusions: Defaulters to any bank or financial institution
documents_required: Business Plan or Quotation of Machinery/Items to Purchase
application_steps: Visit the JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or any commercial bank/MFI branch.
Select the Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun loan category and submit your business proposal.
Receive loan disbursement directly into your account or vendor account.
